title: Pure-tensor coface equation for normalized singleton sections
statement: Let X,F,U,W,g,A,B,M,C,T be as in the singleton tensor-section construction, without requiring U or W affine. Suppose e(n):T.X(n)≅C.X(n) satisfy IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison for every n. For each n, j:Fin(n+2), m in M and b:Fin(n+1)→B, the composites e(n).hom followed by the j-th Cech coface and the lifted Amitsur j-th coface followed by e(n+1).hom agree when evaluated at ULift(m tensor tprod(b)). This states only the equation on a single indexed pure tensor; it asserts no bijectivity and constructs no complex isomorphism. [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison] [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]

source.place: Tag 03P2, Theorem 59.22.4, affine-case proof, singleton Cech/Amitsur calculation; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03P2

proof.text: The Amitsur coface maps the indexed pure tensor tprod(b) to tprod(j.insertNth 1 b). Express tprod(b) as a product of single-factor inclusions and use amitsurMap_comp_singleAlgHom. Under the degree normalization this is the product of the retained projection functions times the restriction of m.

Evaluate the Cech coface at the unique tuple: it is section restriction along the product map omitting j. Semilinearity moves the product of projection functions through restriction; composition of restrictions gives the direct coefficient restriction.

The product projection equations identify the retained functions, while the inserted one is a unit. Thus the evaluated sections agree; singleton evaluation and ULift are injective, so the original group elements agree.

theorem singletonTensorDegreeComparison_pure_coface
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ≅
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (he : ∀ n, IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison X F U W g n (e n)) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) := g.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2))
      (m : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤))
      (b : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(W.left, ⊤)),
      ((e n).hom ≫ (singletonTensorCechCosimplicial X F U W g).δ j)
        (ULift.up (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)] PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) b)) =
      ((singletonTensorForget U.left).map
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.amitsurCosimplicialObject Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤)
          Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)).δ j) ≫ (e (n + 1)).hom)
            (ULift.up (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)] PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) b))
